ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and peripheral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) contiguous region originating at the median notch and radiating laterally into both lobes. Fine-grained low-intensity mottling and punctate spots scattered across the high-intensity (white) field of both lateral lobes. Continuous low-intensity banding along the trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate vertex angle of 40 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1.2:1.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern characterized by numerous irregular peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels) across the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the leading edges with a positive upward sweep terminating in acute, slightly hooked fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular low-intensity clusters (approx. 10-pixel diameter) on the left lobe and three smaller clusters on the mid-right lobe, consistent with barnacle scar morphology.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent reddish-brown linear pixel disruption (approx. 80 pixels in length) oriented horizontally on the lower quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable reddish-brown linear lesion on the right lobe; several deep, irregular notches on the trailing edge of the right fluke tip indicative of historical mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'feathered' gradient transition between the central black pigmentation and the white field, particularly on the interior margins of the right lobe.
